text:
The organ that pumps blood is the heart.

In the narrative provided, the **melody** serves as the central motif, weaving through the characters' lives like a hidden current. Just as the heart rhythmically pumps blood to sustain life and connect every part of the body, the melody pulses through the community, connecting disparate individuals. It acts as the lifeblood of their shared experience, transforming isolated stories into a unified whole. The lullaby, once a source of individual peace, becomes the communal pulse, reminding us that beneath the surface of our separate existences, we are all driven by the same enduring rhythm.
